title: Rav Huna son of Rav Ilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yoma 35a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.35a.4). Hyman reports Dikdukei Soferim’s reading Rav Ulla son of Rav Ilai and says this Rav Huna is not found elsewhere in the Talmud.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The claim that this Rav Huna does not occur elsewhere in the Talmud is Hyman’s observation, not the result of a new exhaustive search. The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 35a has Rav Huna son of Rav Ilai.
The linked Yoma names Rav Huna son of Rav Ilai expounding the repeated word “linen.” The alternative Hyman cites from Dikdukei Soferim is retained as his report.
